- Languages: English and Malay (fluent), Indonesian (intermediate), Japanese and Mandarin (beginner)

## Services
- Back-end and full-stack development: APIs, databases, business logic, Vue and React front ends
- Business systems: booking, finance, registration, membership and POS systems, with online payment gateways
- AI automation: assistants, automated reports and notifications, automated data entry

- Restaurant POS and QR table ordering (demo). Laravel, React, MySQL
- Gold shop membership system (client, live): members, bonuses, reward points, e-wallet. PHP, MySQL
- School registration and billing (client, live): automatic invoices, multiple user roles, WhatsApp. PHP, MySQL
- Mosque finance system (client, live): cash in and out, payment reminders, public report, Excel export. Laravel, Vue, MySQL
- myDay, habit and finance tracker (personal, live at https://myday.afifzuhdi.com/): habits, spending, meals and workouts, AI food-photo analysis. PHP, Vue, MySQL
- Pet hotel staff system (demo): bookings, room assignment, add-on services, a guard against double-booking the last room. Laravel, Vue, MySQL
